  COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM orders
GROUP BY order_id;
select:

where-order:
SELECT
  order_id,
  status = 'paid' AS status_ok,
  amount >= 100 AS amount_ok,
  paid_at IS NOT NULL AS date_ok,
  status = 'paid'
    AND amount >= 100
    AND paid_at IS NOT NULL AS keep_row
FROM orders;

SELECT
  order_id,
  amount,
  paid_at
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
  AND amount >= 100
  AND paid_at IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  order_id,
  amount,
  paid_at
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
  AND amount >= 100
  AND paid_at IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY amount DESC;
aggregate:
SELECT

group-by:
SELECT
  order_id,
  customer_id,
  amount
FROM orders;

SELECT
  customer_id,
  GROUP_CONCAT(order_id ORDER BY order_id) AS order_ids,
  GROUP_CONCAT(amount ORDER BY order_id) AS amount_values
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id;

SELECT
  customer_id,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id;
having:
SELECT
  city,
  amount,
  status
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid';

SELECT
  city,
  GROUP_CONCAT(amount ORDER BY amount) AS amount_values
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY city;

SELECT
  city,
  AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY city;

SELECT
  city,
  AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
GROUP BY city
HAVING AVG(amount) >= 150;
join:
SELECT
  u.user_id,
  u.user_name
FROM users AS u;

SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.user_id,
  o.amount
FROM orders AS o;

SELECT
  u.user_id,
  GROUP_CONCAT(o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id) AS matched_order_ids,
  COUNT(o.order_id) AS matched_rows
FROM users AS u
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON u.user_id = o.user_id
GROUP BY u.user_id;

SELECT
  u.user_id,
  u.user_name,
  o.order_id,
  o.amount
FROM users AS u
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
  ON u.user_id = o.user_id
ORDER BY u.user_id, o.order_id;
subquery:
SELECT
  order_id,
  amount
FROM orders
WHERE amount > (
  SELECT AVG(amount)
  FROM orders
);
case-when:
SELECT
  user_id,
  total_spend,
  CASE
    WHEN total_spend >= 500 THEN '第一个 WHEN'
    WHEN total_spend >= 200 THEN '第二个 WHEN'
    ELSE 'ELSE'
  END AS matched_branch
FROM users;

SELECT
  user_id,
  total_spend,
  CASE
    WHEN total_spend >= 500 THEN '高价值'
    WHEN total_spend >= 200 THEN '中价值'
    ELSE '低价值'
  END AS value_segment
FROM users;
window:
SELECT
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sale_date) AS row_num,
  sale_date,
  sales
FROM daily_sales;

SELECT
  sale_date,
  sales,
  SUM(sales) OVER (
    ORDER BY sale_date
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS window_sum
FROM daily_sales;

SELECT
  sale_date,
  sales,
  SUM(sales) OVER (
    ORDER BY sale_date
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS cumulative_sales
FROM daily_sales;

  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'paid'
)

WITH paid_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, user_id, amount
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'paid'
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS buyers,
  SUM(amount) AS gmv,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM paid_orders;

WITH paid_orders AS (
  SELECT order_id, user_id, amount
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'paid'
),
buyer_orders AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM paid_orders
  GROUP BY user_id
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(amount) / COUNT(*) FROM paid_orders) AS aov,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS repeat_buyer_rate
FROM buyer_orders;

SELECT
  'users' AS table_name,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count,
  SUM(user_id IS NULL) AS null_key_count,
  MIN(register_date) AS min_date,
  MAX(register_date) AS max_date
FROM users
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'orders', COUNT(*), SUM(order_id IS NULL), MIN(order_date), MAX(order_date)
FROM orders;

SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.user_id,
  u.city,
  o.order_date,
  o.amount
FROM orders AS o
JOIN users AS u
  ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid';

WITH clean_order_detail AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, u.city, o.order_date, o.amount
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE o.status = 'paid'
)
SELECT
  user_id,
  city,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  SUM(amount) AS total_spend
FROM clean_order_detail
GROUP BY user_id, city;

WITH clean_order_detail AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, u.city, o.amount
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
  WHERE o.status = 'paid'
),
user_metrics AS (
  SELECT user_id, city, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(amount) AS total_spend
  FROM clean_order_detail
  GROUP BY user_id, city
)
SELECT
  city,
  COUNT(*) AS buyers,
  SUM(total_spend) AS gmv,
  AVG(total_spend) AS avg_spend,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_count >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_buyers
FROM user_metrics
GROUP BY city;
